spanish: Y comerán viejo añejo, y viejo de faces de nuevo sacarán.

findings.issue: Niphal passive participle rendered as the adjective añejo; the grown-old sense stays, the participle category is smoothed.
de nuevo is licensed as from-faces-of the new, but the same string is the Spanish adverb again, so the substantive new can be misread.

notes: 2mp weqatal and hiphil as comerán/sacarán are ustedes address.
